name: christopherowen/spark-ds41f
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash official weights now run on one DGX Spark via spark-ds41f 1120, with per-topology speeds
summary: The spark-ds41f repo's 1120 release adds single-machine and two-machine direct-cable configs for the original DeepSeek V4.1 Flash weights, reading experts that do not fit in memory from disk through io_uring. Reported single-stream decode is 4.4 tok/s on one Spark and 17.8 on two, rising to 124 on eight; prefill is slow on one and two machines, so a compressed build is still the practical choice t

appearances.title: Four DGX Sparks run the official 475 GiB DeepSeek V4.1 Flash checkpoint at about 88 tok/s single stream with vLLM TP=4
appearances.summary: A home-cluster write-up of cold prefill at 8.5K tok/s on 32K input, about 2 minutes from cold start to API, and a ring-wired network matching a switch (23.8 vs 24.1 GB/s NCCL). Two Sparks only fit a 2.8 to 2.9 bpw EXL3 build, which does 153.5 tok/s aggregate at 4 streams on TensorFold.

appearances.title: vLLM and SGLang recipes run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash across four DGX Sparks
appearances.summary: A builder compared two community recipes for serving DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with tensor parallelism across four DGX Sparks: vLLM using christopherowen's 1107 branch, which placed first in the write-up, and SGLang using majewskizby's 2.7 recipe. Both recipe repos are public; the vLLM branch is noted as not yet a finished release.
